findings.title: Bowie State University (BSU) did not ensure that adjustments to student accounts were proper and did not refer delinquent accounts to the State’s Central Collection Unit as required.
findings.description: BSU failed to timely review $7.5 million in adjustments to student accounts made during calendar year 2023 until February 2024. Additionally, BSU had not referred delinquent accounts to the Central Collection Unit (CCU) as of September 2024, with 2,860 accounts totaling $13.4 million outstanding more than 265 days.

dollar_amounts.context: adjustments to student accounts made during calendar year 2023
student accounts with balances of at least $1,000 totaling outstanding more than 265 days
test of 10 material adjustments made in calendar year 2023

findings.recommendation: a. perform timely and comprehensive reviews of adjustments to student accounts, at least on a test basis; and b. refer delinquent student accounts to CCU in accordance with its agreement with CCU.
